thread:
Maya Fernandez: quick heads up — after the quant8x4 bring-up overnight we saw a spike in duplicate prompts hitting the labeler queue. queue +420, golden overlap rising

Jonah Kim: ugh. any idea on a root cause?

Priya Rao: labeler lead — seeing fingerprint collisions in seedbank ingestion; dedupe threshold seems too permissive for tokenized vs normalized variants. collision rate ~12%. pausing new ingest now.

Kai Liu: thanks. can someone run a dedupe sweep with a higher sim threshold? propose 0.92 cosine on embed fingerprint and 3-way microgolden consensus for contested samples.

Priya Rao: plan: 1) pause ingest 2) run `dedupe-sweep --thresh 0.92 --backfill 1200` 3) mark contested for 3-review consensus (microgolden)

Maya Fernandez: @ops-bot run /inspect-queue --team labelers --last 3h

ops-bot: (bot) running inspect...
```
queue_length: 432
golden_overlap_pct: 11.8
top_reason: duplicate_fingerprint
most_affected_source: web-scrape-v2
```

labeler-bot: (bot) flagged 980 samples as potential duplicates. recommended action: `microgolden-refresh --size 1200 --consensus 3 --tag dedupe-sweep`

Jonah Kim: what about regression risk on existing golden sets? we don't want to destabilize evals mid-onboard.

Priya Rao: propose a microgolden-compare step: sample 200 holdouts from current golden vs post-dedupe candidates, run eval harness; if quality delta > 1.5% fail and rollback.

Kai Liu: i'll open a canary route on staging with quant8-lite and run the eval harness after dedupe completes. need the sample list path exported.

Maya Fernandez: owners: @Priya on dedupe, @Kai on canary + eval harness, @Jonah on rollback policy coordination.

Priya Rao: starting dedupe-sweep now. ETA ~2.5h for microgolden set to be ready. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maya Fernandez: export query for audit and post results to triage bucket:
```sql
SELECT fingerprint, count(*) AS cnt
FROM samplebank
WHERE created_ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY fingerprint
HAVING count(*) > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Jonah Kim: saved CSV -> s3://redwood-dev/triage/4781234567/dupes.csv :thumbsup:

ops-bot: (bot) ingest paused. task_id=ingest.pause user=Maya Fernandez

Priya Rao: will ping here when microgolden refresh + consensus labels are done.

Maya Fernandez: thanks team. if labeler capacity is a blocker i'll ping growth for temp coverage.
